entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who comes to Zendikar to solve the puzzle of the hedrons and find a way to stop the Eldrazi titan Ulamog.

entities.name: Zada
entities.description: A strong, cheerful goblin of Slab Haven who fights with a pestle and mortar, grinds hedrons for magic, and guides Jace to the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker who helped build the Eye of Ugin and the hedron network and imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar; he is believed long dead by Jace but appears in the flesh.

entities.name: Tuktuk
entities.description: The goblin leader of the Tuktuk tribe, made of rocks, whom Zada says she ate.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker and rival of Ugin who manipulated Jace and others into releasing the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker, self-proclaimed lord of Innistrad and an erstwhile ally of Ugin, who helped imprison the Eldrazi; Ugin warns he is selfish.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor planeswalker of Zendikar and its guardian, who made the hedrons and has gone missing.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan on Zendikar that is headed toward Sea Gate; Ugin says it dwells in the Blind Eternities and cannot be killed.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A person whose mind Jace read to obtain a mental map of Akoum.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A planeswalker shown in Jace's illusion standing tall and inspiring the survivors.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A planeswalker shown in Jace's illusion communing with the land.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Jace thinks of as an ally on Innistrad.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the hedron network once contained the Eldrazi and which is now being ravaged by them.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A region of Zendikar of jagged volcanic rock and treacherous canyons, rearranged when the Eldrazi emerged.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The cavern at the center of the hedron network, built by Ugin, where the Eldrazi were imprisoned.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A center of civilization and learning on the coast of Tazeem, whose hedron scholarship was lost and where survivors have gathered.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The home plane of Sorin Markov.

entities.name: Teeth of Akoum
entities.description: The mountain range from which the three Eldrazi progenitors emerged.

entities.name: Tuktuk tribe
entities.description: A tribe of goblins who lived in Akoum under Tuktuk.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Vast alien beings, including titans and their brood, who were imprisoned on Zendikar and have been released.

entities.name: Hedron network
entities.description: The network of floating stone hedrons and leylines on Zendikar that was designed to contain the Eldrazi and now lies damaged.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, where Ugin says the Eldrazi titans truly dwell.

events.summary: Jace climbs a cliff in Akoum in search of the Tuktuk goblins and hauls himself over the lip straight into an Eldrazi.
events.quote: —and straight into an Eldrazi.

events.summary: Jace's illusion fails against the Eldrazi, but Zada kills it with a blow from her pestle after a flash of blue light.
events.quote: just as a heavy club came down on its blank white head.

events.summary: Zada reveals she ground up a hedron to fuel her spell and tells Jace that hedrons hold magic.
events.quote: A hedron holds magic for a thousand years,

events.summary: Zada says Tuktuk is dead because she ate him, as goblins eat magic rocks to grow stronger.
events.quote: "I ate him," said Zada.

events.summary: Zada agrees to lead Jace to the Eye of Ugin, noting the hedron network has no center now.
events.quote: But I suppose I'll show you the way, if you think it's important,

events.summary: Zada leaves Jace at a cave entrance, warning that nobody goes in.
events.quote: Nobody goes in there. Bad magic. Certain death. Good luck!

events.summary: Jace descends into the ruined Eye of Ugin and sees a glow ahead and the stones growing orderly.
events.quote: the stones around him became more orderly

events.summary: A dragon unfolds from the shadows; Jace fears it is Bolas, but it introduces itself as Ugin, builder of the Eye.
events.quote: My name is Ugin. I helped build this place, long ago.

events.summary: Ugin reveals he knows Jace was one of three planeswalkers who opened the Eye, manipulated by Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: You, a pyromancer, and a dragonspeaker. Planeswalkers all. You opened the Eye.

events.summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
events.quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
events.quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

events.summary: Jace and Ugin argue over whether the hedrons can be relied on again, and Ugin insists the earlier release was orchestrated.
events.quote: It was not an accident,

events.summary: Ugin conjures an illusion of the hedron network as it was, how it drifted without the Lithomancer, and how it stands now, shattered.
events.quote: The hedron network as it stands,

events.summary: Jace counters Ugin's illusion with scenes of Sea Gate and of Zendikar's suffering people, insisting Zendikar is somebody's home.
events.quote: Zendikar isn't a puzzle to be solved,

events.summary: Jace understands a circular glyph with three points that the leylines could be coaxed into forming.
events.quote: A glyph—circular, with three points at equal intervals around the circumference.

events.summary: Ugin says he is here to save the Multiverse, not the people of Zendikar.
events.quote: With the Eldrazi at large, the entire Multiverse is at risk.

events.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
events.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

events.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
events.quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

events.summary: Jace privately realizes the hedrons might pull the Eldrazi fully into the physical realm so they could be killed, and keeps the idea to himself.
events.quote: You could pull him into the pond.

events.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi brood are connected to the titans like cells or organs, so killing them achieves nothing.
events.quote: More like cells,

events.summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
events.quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

events.summary: Jace agrees but privately resolves to proceed his own way, and leaves the Eye with a plan.
events.quote: He had a plan. He had a destination. He was ready.

relations.note: Ugin says he helped build it.
relations.quote: I helped build this place, long ago.

relations.note: Ugin calls Bolas a rival of his.
relations.quote: By another dragon Planeswalker, a rival of mine

relations.note: Ugin calls Sorin his erstwhile ally.
relations.quote: He is my erstwhile ally, self-proclaimed lord of his home plane of Innistrad.
He is my erstwhile ally, self-proclaimed lord of his home plane of Innistrad.

relations.note: Nahiri is a kor of Zendikar and its guardian.
relations.quote: A kor of Zendikar, and its guardian.

relations.note: Jace says Bolas has manipulated him before.
relations.quote: This wouldn't be the first time he's manipulated me.
